entities.summary: Zachary Rinaldo is a Canadian former professional ice hockey left winger. He has previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Philadelphia Flyers, Boston Bruins, Arizona Coyotes, Nashville Predators and Calgary Flames. He is known for his rough and physical style of play and for being an enforcer. He is currently serving as Head Coach of the Pelham Panthers of the Greater Ontario Junior Hockey League.
